title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani earns Rajeshwari's appreciation with her health mix despite past humiliation. Later, Anbu surprises Kanmani with a decorated swing, fulfilling her wish.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Nalini uncover the shocking truth that Anand's adoptive mother is an impostor. Paraman later struggles to identify the real buyer of the gun used in Ashok's murder.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Swetha encourages Mahesh to stay strong as others taunt him about his father's crime. Meanwhile, Abinaya plans to move to Bangalore with Sudar after securing a job.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: At the village elders' request, Manjamalai invites Mayandi to their temple festival. Unwilling to face those who humiliated her, Meenatchi refuses to accompany Mayandi.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi's worsening health due to tension leads Bagyaraj and Mathi to take her to the hospital. Malar is shocked to see Thangaraj arrive at her mother's home after following them.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Raji suspects the brothers, while Kathir and Senthil support Saravanan's secret wedding with Anjali. Later, Gomathi unknowingly helps Saravanan quit his job at Pandian's shop.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan worries that Chandayatha may create trouble for the family. Meanwhile, Chandayatha wakes up early to handle the household chores, with Nila rising early to help her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Nachiyar praises Vijaya and invites Rohini and Manoj to lunch. As Annamalai and Nachiyar depart for the village, Muthu, Meena, and Annamalai join her, hiding her memory loss.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu gets coolers for Vellathai and Perumatha, while Abinav hands Eshwari and Chithra poisoned eye drops at the camp. Later, Vellathai's demand for care shocks everyone.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Sethupathi pressures Kasthuri to accept his love and warns her against Karthik's interference. Madhu is later upset as Arjun remains firm on his decision to leave the company.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan and his brothers take on the scammers and hand them over to the police. Meanwhile, Kandhasamy rejoices after recovering their hard-earned money.
